reading.body:
This record is an OpenStreetMap tag, not a verified data center, and it carries zero megawatts of capacity.

The entry is a single facility in Poland, tagged telecom=data_center, named Korbank, and located 4.4 miles from Copernicus Wrocław Airport. The name matches a Polish IT company that sells business software and infrastructure services. If that match is right, the site is more likely a corporate office running internal IT and a small hosting operation than a commercial colocation hall. The record itself supplies no operator, no website, and no power figure.

That distinction matters for AI because the binding constraints are power and buildings, and this entry speaks to neither. A software company's server room and a colocation campus both get tagged the same way in OpenStreetMap, so a count of such tags cannot be read as a count of available compute. The zero in the megawatt field is not a measurement of this site, it is the absence of one.

The data also does not confirm that Korbank operates this facility, or that the company is still in the same business. The research note states that independent confirmation failed because the search quota ran out, and the only source listed is a tagging review. Treat this as a location with a plausible name attached, and nothing more.
